description: The Geostationary Ocean Color Imager (GOCI) observed ocean colour in eight bands between 412 and 865 nm. Its repeated daytime observations support studies of sediment, water properties and coastal ocean changes.
short_description: COMS Geostationary Ocean Color Imager (GOCI) bands, 412-865 nm
facility_description: COMS was a South Korean communications, ocean and meteorological satellite carrying GOCI.
notes: The KIOST repository describes mission and band coverage but its article copyright notice is not a licence for the filter curves. Existing NJM curve source is an IOCCG spreadsheet; redistribution permission and requested provider acknowledgement remain unverified.

licence.scope: Host-site footer; KIOST terms not checked.
